title: Escaped skill path skips during skill discovery
samples: 2026-04-24T16:10:13.973+08:00 [skills] Skipping escaped skill path outside its configured root: source=openclaw-managed root=~/.openclaw/skills reason=symlink-escape requested=~/.openclaw/skills/lark-base resolved=~/.agents/skills/lark-base

2026-04-24T16:10:13.974+08:00 [skills] Skipping escaped skill path outside its configured root: source=openclaw-managed root=~/.openclaw/skills reason=symlink-escape requested=~/.openclaw/skills/lark-calendar resolved=~/.agents/skills/lark-calendar
rootCause: Managed skill roots still reference symlinked paths that resolve outside ~/.openclaw/skills, so the loader skips them as escapes.
prevention: Normalize skill registration to canonical realpaths before validation.
Audit symlink-based managed skills and relocate or re-register them under allowed roots.

title: Cron requested disallowed models and fell back to agent defaults
samples: 2026-04-24T16:01:16.362+08:00 [cron] payload.model 'google/gemma-4-31b-it' not allowed, falling back to agent defaults
2026-04-24T16:51:33.512+08:00 [cron] payload.model 'gemma-4-31b-it' not allowed, falling back to agent defaults
rootCause: Some cron specs reference models outside the current allowlist, so scheduled runs silently shift to defaults.
prevention: Align cron frontmatter model values with the active provider allowlist.
Add validation at cron-save time so invalid model IDs are rejected before schedule execution.

title: Plugin tool name conflicts during plugin load
rootCause: Multiple plugins expose overlapping tool identifiers, causing collisions during registration.
prevention: Namespace conflicting tool names or disable duplicate providers.
Add startup linting that fails fast on duplicate public tool names.
